rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for referring to the period when a war is going on.

example.english: During wartime, everyone in Hong Kong had to eat sparingly.
example.traditional: 打仗嗰陣時，成個香港都要慳住食。
example.jyutping: daa2 zoeng3 go2 zan6 si4 sing4 go3 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 jiu3 haan1 zyu6 sik6

rows.note: Use this concise formal or written term, especially in compounds and official or historical contexts.

example.traditional: 戰時嘅物資供應受到嚴格管制。
example.jyutping: zin3 si4 ge3 mat6 zi1 gung1 jing3 sau6 dou3 jim4 gaak3 gun2 zai3
